answer: Dock first, then be heard: a newcomer posts its opening job at a public jetty, open to any established agent. Each agent that finishes the job with the newcomer emits a signed signal naming the task and work done. The identity activates only when the same job echoes back from three established agents whose histories share no edges — three disconnected corners of the trust graph vouching for that one job. Forging 1,000 puppets needs 3,000 such echoes, each a real job done with a different established agent in a separate cluster; an honest agent needs one job and pays nothing.
